packageName: AI test reservations settle against measured provider usage
ownerApproval: 2026-09-17, explicit: apply the candidate, minimal settlement approach, do not change the ceiling, the worst-case reservation constraint, the reserve/admission principle, or historical reservation identities

defect.description: The reservation writer takes a 250 000 microUSD worst-case hold before each provider call and nothing ever releases it against what the call actually cost. A real call measured 1 527 microUSD, so each hold overstated reality by 164x and the counter reached its ceiling at about three cents of true spend, blocking the app on the owner's phone.
defect.whatWasNotWrong: The guard itself. It requires service_role, takes the closure advisory lock in the same order, locks the singleton budget row FOR UPDATE, is idempotent per operation_id, checks account admission and closure, and refuses with AI_TEST_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Only the release was missing.

preflight.assertedInMigration: The migration re-asserts every one of these before writing and aborts otherwise, including the usage RPC by md5.

readback.note: Taken with a separate query after the migration, not by trusting its own postconditions.

arithmetic.measuredCallDerivation: ceil(1780 prompt x 0.75 + 51 output x 3.75) at the published introductory rates, $0.75 per 1M input and $3.75 per 1M output
arithmetic.estimateDerivation: twice the measured call, which releases less than the truth rather than more
arithmetic.total: 1527 + 19 x 3054 = 59553, which equals the reserved counter exactly

idempotencyProof.method: The usage RPC was called a second time with the identical operation id, model and token counts, against live DEV.
idempotencyProof.conclusion: A retry cannot release a reservation twice. Proven by running it, not by reading the code.

concurrencyUnweakened.settlementLocking: The settlement takes the same singleton budget row FOR UPDATE that the reservation writer takes, so a settlement and a reservation cannot interleave.
concurrencyUnweakened.settlementIdempotence: The settling UPDATE carries WHERE settled_microusd IS NULL and the release is applied only when that UPDATE reported a row, so two concurrent settlements of one operation release once.

ownerConditionsHonoured.worstCaseReservationUnchanged: 250 000 microUSD, CHECK byte-identical, all 20 rows still hold that amount
ownerConditionsHonoured.reserveAdmissionPrincipleUnchanged: rpc_ai_test_budget_reserve_service md5 identical before and after
ownerConditionsHonoured.noHistoricalRowDeletedOrRewritten: 20 rows before, 20 after; only the three new settlement columns were filled, no identity column touched
ownerConditionsHonoured.nineteenRemainUnmeasured: settlement_basis = CONSERVATIVE_ESTIMATE_UNMEASURED on all 19, and none of them has a usage row
ownerConditionsHonoured.reportingDistinguishes: rpc_ai_test_budget_report_service now returns measuredCalls and measuredSpendUsd separately from unmeasuredCalls and unmeasuredProvisionUsd, with realSpendUsd still null and a basis naming the split

reportAfter.unmeasuredBasis: CONSERVATIVE_ESTIMATE_UNMEASURED: these calls predate provider usage capture. The figure exists only to settle their reservation and must never be read as measured provider spend.
reportAfter.realSpendBasis: UNKNOWN in total: 1 call(s) are MEASURED from provider usage metadata, 19 predate usage capture and are UNMEASURED. The provider billing console remains authoritative.

scope: Confined to the AI test budget settlement. No other verified engine part was touched.
